description: Students translate selections from one or more genres of ancient Greek literature while exploring a specific topic or theme chosen by the instructor. Close study of the text is combined with discussion of broader literary, historical, and cultural questions. Sample topics: "Tales of Odysseus," "Hellenistic Greek," "Famous Speeches in Ancient Greek Texts." Offered periodically in the fall or the spring semester. Prerequisite: GREEK 231 or equivalent.
name: Top: Alcibiades in Fact and Fiction
title: Topics in Greek Literature
